        private static T ReadFallback<T>(object value)
        {

                return typed;

            global::System.Type target = typeof(T);

            if (target.IsEnum)

                    : (T)global::System.Enum.ToObject(target, global::System.Convert.ChangeType(value, global::System.Enum.GetUnderlyingType(target), global::System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
            }

            if (target == typeof(char) && value is string charText)
                return (T)(object)(charText.Length > 0 ? charText[0] : '\0');

            if (target == typeof(global::System.DateOnly))
            {

                    : global::System.DateOnly.FromDateTime(global::System.Convert.ToDateTime(value, global::System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)));
            }

            if (target == typeof(global::System.TimeOnly))
            {

                return (T)(object)global::System.TimeOnly.FromDateTime(global::System.Convert.ToDateTime(value, global::System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
            }
        #endif

            // Convert.ChangeType cannot reach these - none of them is IConvertible-convertible
            // from string - and a provider on the IDataReader path may well hand back text.
            if (value is string text)
            {
                if (target == typeof(global::System.TimeSpan))
                    return (T)(object)global::System.TimeSpan.Parse(text, global::System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
                if (target == typeof(global::System.DateTimeOffset))
                    return (T)(object)global::System.DateTimeOffset.Parse(text, global::System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
                if (target == typeof(global::System.Guid))
                    return (T)(object)global::System.Guid.Parse(text);
            }

            if (target == typeof(global::System.DateTimeOffset) && value is global::System.DateTime dateTime)
                return (T)(object)new global::System.DateTimeOffset(dateTime);

            if (target == typeof(global::System.Guid) && value is byte[])

                    $"Cannot convert a value of type '{value.GetType().FullName}' to '{target.FullName}'. " +

                    "will not guess it.");

                    if (!r.IsDBNull(ord[25]))
                        entity.NullableText = (__jauntyHasHandlers && global::Extrode.Jaunty.Core.GeneratedBindingSupport.HasHandlerFor<string>() ? global::Extrode.Jaunty.Core.GeneratedBindingSupport.FromDbValue<string>(r.GetValue(ord[25])) : r.GetString(ord[25]));
                    entity.CharValue = (__jauntyHasHandlers && global::Extrode.Jaunty.Core.GeneratedBindingSupport.HasHandlerFor<char>() ? global::Extrode.Jaunty.Core.GeneratedBindingSupport.FromDbValue<char>(r.GetValue(ord[26])) : ReadFallback<char>(r.GetValue(ord[26])));
                    entity.UnsignedInt = (__jauntyHasHandlers && global::Extrode.Jaunty.Core.GeneratedBindingSupport.HasHandlerFor<uint>() ? global::Extrode.Jaunty.Core.GeneratedBindingSupport.FromDbValue<uint>(r.GetValue(ord[27])) : ReadFallback<uint>(r.GetValue(ord[27])));
                    entity.UnsignedLong = (__jauntyHasHandlers && global::Extrode.Jaunty.Core.GeneratedBindingSupport.HasHandlerFor<ulong>() ? global::Extrode.Jaunty.Core.GeneratedBindingSupport.FromDbValue<ulong>(r.GetValue(ord[28])) : ReadFallback<ulong>(r.GetValue(ord[28])));
                    entity.SignedByte = (__jauntyHasHandlers && global::Extrode.Jaunty.Core.GeneratedBindingSupport.HasHandlerFor<sbyte>() ? global::Extrode.Jaunty.Core.GeneratedBindingSupport.FromDbValue<sbyte>(r.GetValue(ord[29])) : ReadFallback<sbyte>(r.GetValue(ord[29])));
                    entity.UnsignedShort = (__jauntyHasHandlers && global::Extrode.Jaunty.Core.GeneratedBindingSupport.HasHandlerFor<ushort>() ? global::Extrode.Jaunty.Core.GeneratedBindingSupport.FromDbValue<ushort>(r.GetValue(ord[30])) : ReadFallback<ushort>(r.GetValue(ord[30])));
                    entity.DateOnlyValue = (__jauntyHasHandlers && global::Extrode.Jaunty.Core.GeneratedBindingSupport.HasHandlerFor<global::System.DateOnly>() ? global::Extrode.Jaunty.Core.GeneratedBindingSupport.FromDbValue<global::System.DateOnly>(r.GetValue(ord[31])) : ReadFallback<global::System.DateOnly>(r.GetValue(ord[31])));
                    entity.TimeOnlyValue = (__jauntyHasHandlers && global::Extrode.Jaunty.Core.GeneratedBindingSupport.HasHandlerFor<global::System.TimeOnly>() ? global::Extrode.Jaunty.Core.GeneratedBindingSupport.FromDbValue<global::System.TimeOnly>(r.GetValue(ord[32])) : ReadFallback<global::System.TimeOnly>(r.GetValue(ord[32])));
                    if (!r.IsDBNull(ord[33]))
                        entity.Bytes = (__jauntyHasHandlers && global::Extrode.Jaunty.Core.GeneratedBindingSupport.HasHandlerFor<byte[]>() ? global::Extrode.Jaunty.Core.GeneratedBindingSupport.FromDbValue<byte[]>(r.GetValue(ord[33])) : ReadFallback<byte[]>(r.GetValue(ord[33])));
                    entity.Colour = (__jauntyHasHandlers && global::Extrode.Jaunty.Core.GeneratedBindingSupport.HasHandlerFor<global::Snapshots.EveryType.Colour>() ? global::Extrode.Jaunty.Core.GeneratedBindingSupport.FromDbValue<global::Snapshots.EveryType.Colour>(r.GetValue(ord[34])) : ReadFallback<global::Snapshots.EveryType.Colour>(r.GetValue(ord[34])));
                    if (!r.IsDBNull(ord[35]))
                        entity.NullableColour = (__jauntyHasHandlers && global::Extrode.Jaunty.Core.GeneratedBindingSupport.HasHandlerFor<global::Snapshots.EveryType.Colour>() ? global::Extrode.Jaunty.Core.GeneratedBindingSupport.FromDbValueNullable<global::Snapshots.EveryType.Colour>(r.GetValue(ord[35])) : ReadFallback<global::Snapshots.EveryType.Colour>(r.GetValue(ord[35])));
                    entity.StoredAsString = (__jauntyHasHandlers && global::Extrode.Jaunty.Core.GeneratedBindingSupport.HasHandlerFor<global::Snapshots.EveryType.Colour>() ? global::Extrode.Jaunty.Core.GeneratedBindingSupport.FromDbValue<global::Snapshots.EveryType.Colour>(r.GetValue(ord[36])) : ReadFallback<global::Snapshots.EveryType.Colour>(r.GetValue(ord[36])));
                    if (!r.IsDBNull(ord[37]))
                        entity.StoredAsNumber = (__jauntyHasHandlers && global::Extrode.Jaunty.Core.GeneratedBindingSupport.HasHandlerFor<global::Snapshots.EveryType.Colour>() ? global::Extrode.Jaunty.Core.GeneratedBindingSupport.FromDbValueNullable<global::Snapshots.EveryType.Colour>(r.GetValue(ord[37])) : ReadFallback<global::Snapshots.EveryType.Colour>(r.GetValue(ord[37])));
                    entity.Money = (__jauntyHasHandlers && global::Extrode.Jaunty.Core.GeneratedBindingSupport.HasHandlerFor<global::Snapshots.EveryType.Money>() ? global::Extrode.Jaunty.Core.GeneratedBindingSupport.FromDbValue<global::Snapshots.EveryType.Money>(r.GetValue(ord[38])) : ReadFallback<global::Snapshots.EveryType.Money>(r.GetValue(ord[38])));
                    if (!r.IsDBNull(ord[39]))
                        entity.Anything = (__jauntyHasHandlers && global::Extrode.Jaunty.Core.GeneratedBindingSupport.HasHandlerFor<object>() ? global::Extrode.Jaunty.Core.GeneratedBindingSupport.FromDbValue<object>(r.GetValue(ord[39])) : ReadFallback<object>(r.GetValue(ord[39])));
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    ThrowIfNonNullableColumnIsNull(r, ord, ex);
                    throw;
                }
                return entity;
            };
        }

        private static void ThrowIfNonNullableColumnIsNull(IDataReader reader, int[] ord, Exception inner)
        {
            if (reader.IsDBNull(ord[0]))
                throw new global::System.InvalidOperationException("Cannot assign NULL to non-nullable property 'Id'.", inner);
            if (reader.IsDBNull(ord[1]))
                throw new global::System.InvalidOperationException("Cannot assign NULL to non-nullable property 'LongValue'.", inner);
            if (reader.IsDBNull(ord[2]))
                throw new global::System.InvalidOperationException("Cannot assign NULL to non-nullable property 'BoolValue'.", inner);
            if (reader.IsDBNull(ord[3]))
                throw new global::System.InvalidOperationException("Cannot assign NULL to non-nullable property 'DecimalValue'.", inner);
            if (reader.IsDBNull(ord[4]))
                throw new global::System.InvalidOperationException("Cannot assign NULL to non-nullable property 'DoubleValue'.", inner);
            if (reader.IsDBNull(ord[5]))
                throw new global::System.InvalidOperationException("Cannot assign NULL to non-nullable property 'FloatValue'.", inner);
            if (reader.IsDBNull(ord[6]))
                throw new global::System.InvalidOperationException("Cannot assign NULL to non-nullable property 'ShortValue'.", inner);
            if (reader.IsDBNull(ord[7]))
                throw new global::System.InvalidOperationException("Cannot assign NULL to non-nullable property 'ByteValue'.", inner);
            if (reader.IsDBNull(ord[8]))
                throw new global::System.InvalidOperationException("Cannot assign NULL to non-nullable property 'GuidValue'.", inner);
            if (reader.IsDBNull(ord[9]))
                throw new global::System.InvalidOperationException("Cannot assign NULL to non-nullable property 'DateTimeValue'.", inner);
            if (reader.IsDBNull(ord[10]))
                throw new global::System.InvalidOperationException("Cannot assign NULL to non-nullable property 'TimeSpanValue'.", inner);
            if (reader.IsDBNull(ord[11]))
                throw new global::System.InvalidOperationException("Cannot assign NULL to non-nullable property 'DateTimeOffsetValue'.", inner);
            if (reader.IsDBNull(ord[26]))
                throw new global::System.InvalidOperationException("Cannot assign NULL to non-nullable property 'CharValue'.", inner);
            if (reader.IsDBNull(ord[27]))
                throw new global::System.InvalidOperationException("Cannot assign NULL to non-nullable property 'UnsignedInt'.", inner);
            if (reader.IsDBNull(ord[28]))
                throw new global::System.InvalidOperationException("Cannot assign NULL to non-nullable property 'UnsignedLong'.", inner);
            if (reader.IsDBNull(ord[29]))
                throw new global::System.InvalidOperationException("Cannot assign NULL to non-nullable property 'SignedByte'.", inner);
            if (reader.IsDBNull(ord[30]))
                throw new global::System.InvalidOperationException("Cannot assign NULL to non-nullable property 'UnsignedShort'.", inner);
            if (reader.IsDBNull(ord[31]))
                throw new global::System.InvalidOperationException("Cannot assign NULL to non-nullable property 'DateOnlyValue'.", inner);
            if (reader.IsDBNull(ord[32]))
                throw new global::System.InvalidOperationException("Cannot assign NULL to non-nullable property 'TimeOnlyValue'.", inner);
            if (reader.IsDBNull(ord[34]))
                throw new global::System.InvalidOperationException("Cannot assign NULL to non-nullable property 'Colour'.", inner);
            if (reader.IsDBNull(ord[36]))
                throw new global::System.InvalidOperationException("Cannot assign NULL to non-nullable property 'StoredAsString'.", inner);
            if (reader.IsDBNull(ord[38]))
                throw new global::System.InvalidOperationException("Cannot assign NULL to non-nullable property 'Money'.", inner);
        }

        public static void BindInsert(IDbCommand command, EveryType entity)
        {
            var p = command.Parameters;
            AddParam(command, p, "@LongValue", entity.LongValue);
            AddParam(command, p, "@BoolValue", entity.BoolValue);
            AddParam(command, p, "@DecimalValue", entity.DecimalValue);
            AddParam(command, p, "@DoubleValue", entity.DoubleValue);
            AddParam(command, p, "@FloatValue", entity.FloatValue);
            AddParam(command, p, "@ShortValue", entity.ShortValue);
            AddParam(command, p, "@ByteValue", entity.ByteValue);
            AddParam(command, p, "@GuidValue", entity.GuidValue);
            AddParam(command, p, "@DateTimeValue", entity.DateTimeValue);
            AddParam(command, p, "@TimeSpanValue", entity.TimeSpanValue);
            AddParam(command, p, "@DateTimeOffsetValue", entity.DateTimeOffsetValue);
            AddParam(command, p, "@NullableInt", entity.NullableInt);
            AddParam(command, p, "@NullableLong", entity.NullableLong);
            AddParam(command, p, "@NullableBool", entity.NullableBool);
            AddParam(command, p, "@NullableDecimal", entity.NullableDecimal);
            AddParam(command, p, "@NullableDouble", entity.NullableDouble);
            AddParam(command, p, "@NullableFloat", entity.NullableFloat);
            AddParam(command, p, "@NullableShort", entity.NullableShort);
            AddParam(command, p, "@NullableByte", entity.NullableByte);
            AddParam(command, p, "@NullableGuid", entity.NullableGuid);
            AddParam(command, p, "@NullableDateTime", entity.NullableDateTime);
            AddParam(command, p, "@NullableTimeSpan", entity.NullableTimeSpan);
            AddParam(command, p, "@NullableDateTimeOffset", entity.NullableDateTimeOffset);
            AddParam(command, p, "@Text", entity.Text);
            AddParam(command, p, "@NullableText", entity.NullableText);
            AddParam(command, p, "@CharValue", entity.CharValue);
            AddParam(command, p, "@UnsignedInt", entity.UnsignedInt);
            AddParam(command, p, "@UnsignedLong", entity.UnsignedLong);
            AddParam(command, p, "@SignedByte", entity.SignedByte);
            AddParam(command, p, "@UnsignedShort", entity.UnsignedShort);
            AddParam(command, p, "@DateOnlyValue", entity.DateOnlyValue);
            AddParam(command, p, "@TimeOnlyValue", entity.TimeOnlyValue);
            AddParam(command, p, "@Bytes", entity.Bytes);
            AddEnumParam(command, p, "@Colour", entity.Colour, (global::Extrode.Jaunty.Attributes.EnumStorage?)null);
            AddEnumParam(command, p, "@NullableColour", entity.NullableColour, (global::Extrode.Jaunty.Attributes.EnumStorage?)null);
            AddEnumParam(command, p, "@StoredAsString", entity.StoredAsString, global::Extrode.Jaunty.Attributes.EnumStorage.String);
            AddEnumParam(command, p, "@StoredAsNumber", entity.StoredAsNumber, global::Extrode.Jaunty.Attributes.EnumStorage.Numeric);
            AddParam(command, p, "@Money", entity.Money);
            AddParam(command, p, "@Anything", entity.Anything);
        }

        public static void BindDelete(IDbCommand command, EveryType entity)
        {
            var p = command.Parameters;
            AddParam(command, p, "@Id", entity.Id);
        }
        private static void AddParam(IDbCommand cmd, IDataParameterCollection pc, string name, object? value)
        {
            var p = cmd.CreateParameter();
            p.ParameterName = name;
            // AUD-R30: route through the same type-handler/enum-storage conversion the
            // reflection binder applies, via the public bridge in Extrode.Jaunty core.
            p.Value = global::Extrode.Jaunty.Core.GeneratedBindingSupport.ToDbValue(value) ?? global::System.DBNull.Value;
            pc.Add(p);
        }

        private static void AddEnumParam(IDbCommand cmd, IDataParameterCollection pc, string name, object? value, global::Extrode.Jaunty.Attributes.EnumStorage? storage)
        {
            var p = cmd.CreateParameter();
            p.ParameterName = name;
            p.Value = global::Extrode.Jaunty.Core.GeneratedBindingSupport.ToDbEnumValue(value, storage) ?? global::System.DBNull.Value;
            pc.Add(p);
        }
        private static class OrdinalMap
        {
            private static readonly ConditionalWeakTable<IDataReader, CacheEntry> _cache = new();
#if !NET8_0_OR_GREATER
            private static readonly object _cacheWriteLock = new();
#endif
            [ThreadStatic]
            private static WeakReference<CacheEntry>? _last;

            public static CacheEntry Resolve(IDataReader reader)
            {
                var lastRef = _last;
                if (lastRef is not null && lastRef.TryGetTarget(out var last) && last.Matches(reader))
                    return last;

                if (_cache.TryGetValue(reader, out var cached) && cached.Matches(reader))
                {
                    SetLast(cached);
                    return cached;
                }

                var ords = new int[40];
                ords[0] = reader.GetOrdinal("Id");
                ords[1] = reader.GetOrdinal("LongValue");
                ords[2] = reader.GetOrdinal("BoolValue");
                ords[3] = reader.GetOrdinal("DecimalValue");
                ords[4] = reader.GetOrdinal("DoubleValue");
                ords[5] = reader.GetOrdinal("FloatValue");
                ords[6] = reader.GetOrdinal("ShortValue");
                ords[7] = reader.GetOrdinal("ByteValue");
                ords[8] = reader.GetOrdinal("GuidValue");
                ords[9] = reader.GetOrdinal("DateTimeValue");
                ords[10] = reader.GetOrdinal("TimeSpanValue");
                ords[11] = reader.GetOrdinal("DateTimeOffsetValue");
                ords[12] = reader.GetOrdinal("NullableInt");
                ords[13] = reader.GetOrdinal("NullableLong");
                ords[14] = reader.GetOrdinal("NullableBool");
                ords[15] = reader.GetOrdinal("NullableDecimal");
                ords[16] = reader.GetOrdinal("NullableDouble");
                ords[17] = reader.GetOrdinal("NullableFloat");
                ords[18] = reader.GetOrdinal("NullableShort");
                ords[19] = reader.GetOrdinal("NullableByte");
                ords[20] = reader.GetOrdinal("NullableGuid");
                ords[21] = reader.GetOrdinal("NullableDateTime");
                ords[22] = reader.GetOrdinal("NullableTimeSpan");
                ords[23] = reader.GetOrdinal("NullableDateTimeOffset");
                ords[24] = reader.GetOrdinal("Text");
                ords[25] = reader.GetOrdinal("NullableText");
                ords[26] = reader.GetOrdinal("CharValue");
                ords[27] = reader.GetOrdinal("UnsignedInt");
                ords[28] = reader.GetOrdinal("UnsignedLong");
                ords[29] = reader.GetOrdinal("SignedByte");
                ords[30] = reader.GetOrdinal("UnsignedShort");
                ords[31] = reader.GetOrdinal("DateOnlyValue");
                ords[32] = reader.GetOrdinal("TimeOnlyValue");
                ords[33] = reader.GetOrdinal("Bytes");
                ords[34] = reader.GetOrdinal("Colour");
                ords[35] = reader.GetOrdinal("NullableColour");
                ords[36] = reader.GetOrdinal("StoredAsString");
                ords[37] = reader.GetOrdinal("StoredAsNumber");
                ords[38] = reader.GetOrdinal("Money");
                ords[39] = reader.GetOrdinal("Anything");
                var entry = new CacheEntry(reader, ords);
#if NET8_0_OR_GREATER
                _cache.AddOrUpdate(reader, entry);
#else
                lock (_cacheWriteLock)
                {
                    _cache.Remove(reader);
                    _cache.Add(reader, entry);
                }
#endif
                SetLast(entry);
                return entry;
            }

            private static void SetLast(CacheEntry entry)
            {
                var lastRef = _last;
                if (lastRef is null)
                    _last = new WeakReference<CacheEntry>(entry);
                else
                    lastRef.SetTarget(entry);
            }

            public sealed class CacheEntry
            {
                private readonly IDataReader _reader;
                private readonly int _fieldCount;

                public CacheEntry(IDataReader reader, int[] ordinals)
                {
                    _reader = reader;
                    _fieldCount = reader.FieldCount;
                    Ordinals = ordinals;
                    DecimalAsDouble = new bool[40];
                    DecimalAsDouble[3] = reader.GetFieldType(ordinals[3]) == typeof(double);
                    DecimalAsDouble[15] = reader.GetFieldType(ordinals[15]) == typeof(double);
                }

                public int[] Ordinals { get; }

                /// <summary>True where a decimal property's column reports double, so it is read through GetDouble.</summary>
                public bool[] DecimalAsDouble { get; }

                public bool Matches(IDataReader reader)
                {
                    if (!ReferenceEquals(reader, _reader))
                        return false;

                    if (reader.FieldCount != _fieldCount)
                        return false;

                    var ord0 = Ordinals[0];
                    if ((uint)ord0 >= (uint)reader.FieldCount)
                        return false;
                    if (!string.Equals(reader.GetName(ord0), "Id", global::System.StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                        return false;

                    var ord1 = Ordinals[1];
                    if ((uint)ord1 >= (uint)reader.FieldCount)
                        return false;
                    if (!string.Equals(reader.GetName(ord1), "LongValue", global::System.StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                        return false;

                    var ord2 = Ordinals[2];
                    if ((uint)ord2 >= (uint)reader.FieldCount)
                        return false;
                    if (!string.Equals(reader.GetName(ord2), "BoolValue", global::System.StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                        return false;

                    var ord3 = Ordinals[3];
                    if ((uint)ord3 >= (uint)reader.FieldCount)
                        return false;
                    if (!string.Equals(reader.GetName(ord3), "DecimalValue", global::System.StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                        return false;

                    var ord4 = Ordinals[4];
                    if ((uint)ord4 >= (uint)reader.FieldCount)
                        return false;
                    if (!string.Equals(reader.GetName(ord4), "DoubleValue", global::System.StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                        return false;

                    var ord5 = Ordinals[5];
                    if ((uint)ord5 >= (uint)reader.FieldCount)
                        return false;
                    if (!string.Equals(reader.GetName(ord5), "FloatValue", global::System.StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                        return false;

                    var ord6 = Ordinals[6];
                    if ((uint)ord6 >= (uint)reader.FieldCount)
                        return false;
                    if (!string.Equals(reader.GetName(ord6), "ShortValue", global::System.StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                        return false;

                    var ord7 = Ordinals[7];
                    if ((uint)ord7 >= (uint)reader.FieldCount)
                        return false;
                    if (!string.Equals(reader.GetName(ord7), "ByteValue", global::System.StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                        return false;

                    var ord8 = Ordinals[8];
                    if ((uint)ord8 >= (uint)reader.FieldCount)
                        return false;
                    if (!string.Equals(reader.GetName(ord8), "GuidValue", global::System.StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                        return false;

                    var ord9 = Ordinals[9];
                    if ((uint)ord9 >= (uint)reader.FieldCount)
                        return false;
                    if (!string.Equals(reader.GetName(ord9), "DateTimeValue", global::System.StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                        return false;

                    var ord10 = Ordinals[10];
                    if ((uint)ord10 >= (uint)reader.FieldCount)
                        return false;
                    if (!string.Equals(reader.GetName(ord10), "TimeSpanValue", global::System.StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                        return false;

                    var ord11 = Ordinals[11];
                    if ((uint)ord11 >= (uint)reader.FieldCount)
                        return false;
                    if (!string.Equals(reader.GetName(ord11), "DateTimeOffsetValue", global::System.StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                        return false;

                    var ord12 = Ordinals[12];
                    if ((uint)ord12 >= (uint)reader.FieldCount)
                        return false;
                    if (!string.Equals(reader.GetName(ord12), "NullableInt", global::System.StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                        return false;

                    var ord13 = Ordinals[13];
                    if ((uint)ord13 >= (uint)reader.FieldCount)
                        return false;
                    if (!string.Equals(reader.GetName(ord13), "NullableLong", global::System.StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                        return false;

                    var ord14 = Ordinals[14];
                    if ((uint)ord14 >= (uint)reader.FieldCount)
                        return false;
                    if (!string.Equals(reader.GetName(ord14), "NullableBool", global::System.StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                        return false;

                    var ord15 = Ordinals[15];
                    if ((uint)ord15 >= (uint)reader.FieldCount)
                        return false;
                    if (!string.Equals(reader.GetName(ord15), "NullableDecimal", global::System.StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                        return false;

                    var ord16 = Ordinals[16];
                    if ((uint)ord16 >= (uint)reader.FieldCount)
                        return false;
                    if (!string.Equals(reader.GetName(ord16), "NullableDouble", global::System.StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                        return false;

                    var ord17 = Ordinals[17];
                    if ((uint)ord17 >= (uint)reader.FieldCount)
                        return false;
                    if (!string.Equals(reader.GetName(ord17), "NullableFloat", global::System.StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                        return false;

                    var ord18 = Ordinals[18];
                    if ((uint)ord18 >= (uint)reader.FieldCount)
                        return false;
                    if (!string.Equals(reader.GetName(ord18), "NullableShort", global::System.StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                        return false;

                    var ord19 = Ordinals[19];
                    if ((uint)ord19 >= (uint)reader.FieldCount)
                        return false;
                    if (!string.Equals(reader.GetName(ord19), "NullableByte", global::System.StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                        return false;

                    var ord20 = Ordinals[20];
                    if ((uint)ord20 >= (uint)reader.FieldCount)
                        return false;
                    if (!string.Equals(reader.GetName(ord20), "NullableGuid", global::System.StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                        return false;

                    var ord21 = Ordinals[21];
                    if ((uint)ord21 >= (uint)reader.FieldCount)
                        return false;
                    if (!string.Equals(reader.GetName(ord21), "NullableDateTime", global::System.StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                        return false;

                    var ord22 = Ordinals[22];
                    if ((uint)ord22 >= (uint)reader.FieldCount)
                        return false;
                    if (!string.Equals(reader.GetName(ord22), "NullableTimeSpan", global::System.StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                        return false;

                    var ord23 = Ordinals[23];
                    if ((uint)ord23 >= (uint)reader.FieldCount)
                        return false;
                    if (!string.Equals(reader.GetName(ord23), "NullableDateTimeOffset", global::System.StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                        return false;

                    var ord24 = Ordinals[24];
                    if ((uint)ord24 >= (uint)reader.FieldCount)
                        return false;
                    if (!string.Equals(reader.GetName(ord24), "Text", global::System.StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                        return false;

                    var ord25 = Ordinals[25];
                    if ((uint)ord25 >= (uint)reader.FieldCount)
                        return false;
                    if (!string.Equals(reader.GetName(ord25), "NullableText", global::System.StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                        return false;

                    var ord26 = Ordinals[26];
                    if ((uint)ord26 >= (uint)reader.FieldCount)
